In a post-apocalyptic Seoul, Nam-san, a relentless wasteland hunter, along with his friend Choi Ji-wan and other survivors, are living a hard life in their village. Nam-san and Ji-wan navigate the desolate wastelands and scavenge for resources to sustain their community. Trouble ensues when Su-na, who is from their village, is kidnapped by a rogue scientist, Dr. Yang Gi-su. Gi-su has been illegally experimenting with making humans immortal by injecting them with a certain serum, which has led to the death of many teenagers. 

It is revealed that Gi-su had been conducting experiments to revive his daughter So-yeon, who had died around the time when Seoul became a wasteland. Gi-su needed more supplies for the serum and had set up a network to bring more teenagers to his camp, located in an apartment complex. Nam-san, Ji-wan, and Lee Eun-ho, a military sergeant of the camp, discover Gi-su's experiments and go to rescue Su-na. Nam-san, Ji-wan, and Eun-ho arrive at the camp and fight with mutant soldiers.
